faq.q: What does it mean to show up for yourself?
faq.a: It means treating your own needs, goals, and well-being as commitments worth keeping, and being as dependable to yourself as you are to others.

faq.q: Is showing up for yourself selfish?
faq.a: No. Taking care of yourself makes you more patient, present, and reliable for the people you love.

faq.q: What are simple things to do for yourself every day?
faq.a: Take a quiet moment before your phone, keep one small promise, move your body, eat one real meal, set one boundary, use kind self-talk, and do a short evening check-in.

faq.q: How much time does daily self-care take?
faq.a: Most of these practices take two to twenty minutes. Small and consistent matters more than long and occasional.

faq.q: What should I do if I skip a day?
faq.a: Try never to miss twice. Do the smallest version of one practice the next day and skip the guilt.

faq.q: Where should I start if I feel overwhelmed?
faq.a: Pick just one practice, like a morning moment or an evening check-in, and do it for a week before adding another.
